samples.source: The stream is starting now, so make sure the audio is turned on.
samples.translation: 现在开始流媒体了，请确保音频已打开。

samples.source: 今日はここまでです。最後まで見てくれて、本当にありがとうございました。
samples.translation: 今天先到这里。非常感谢您一直看到最后。

notes: Index was tested through the same OpenAI-compatible llama-server protocol used by HY-MT2.
The HY comparison used one worker to measure per-request latency; the application normally uses parallel workers, so this is not a whole-job throughput comparison.
Index output was fluent on the English/Japanese samples tested and did not leak the instruction or context.
No default translator setting was changed.
